changelog:
✨ New Features
• Navigation bar: Long press the Settings button to open the other settings
• DeArrow: Add "Clean up titles" setting
• Feed video actions: Keep the thumbnail badges and buttons over the inline preview
• Hide layout components: Split "Hide Chapters and 'In this video' button" into separate settings
• Navigation bar: Add glass navigation bar edge and bottom margin settings
• Add Android Auto parked app mode patch
• Add Open post images in fullscreen patch
• Add Ungroup notifications patch

🌟 Mod Features
• Built with RLX Patches: all Morphe patches for YouTube with the RLX settings, icons and defaults
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio, thumbnail and subtitle downloader with Save to device and offline SponsorBlock
• Recommended settings applied on first start, restorable with "Restore RLX default settings"
• Two variants with all in-app themes: Amoled (Pure Black / White by default) and Original_BBK (clone, Modern Dark / Soft Light by default)
• In-app update check for new builds

🔧 Bug fixes and other improvements
